title: Forecasting How RLHF Responds to Reward-Model Edits Before Training
abstract: arXiv:2611.03244v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Responses with headers, lists and greater length receive high scores from reward models (RMs), and RLHF policies learn to produce these features even when true quality does not improve. Practitioners therefore edit their RMs, but they learn whether an edit works only after an RL run. We show that the response of a policy to an RM edit can be forecast before training, from samples of the current policy and the scores of the old and new RM. If we read the RM as a set of prices, the first-order theory of KL-regularized RL implies that each feature moves in proportion to its within-prompt covariance with the change in reward. We implant controlled price changes into retrained RMs under a 2^(4-1) fractional factorial design with a self-distilled placebo, run 54 RL runs from six parent policies, and fix every forecast before the runs. translated_title: 在训练前预测RLHF如何响应奖励模型的修改
translated_abstract: 带有标题、列表和更长篇幅的回复会从奖励模型（RM）中获得高分，RLHF策略会因此学会产生这些特征，即使真实质量并没有提高。因此从业者会对奖励模型进行修改，但只有在跑完RL训练后才能知道修改是否有效。我们证明，策略对奖励模型修改的响应可以在训练前进行预测，只需利用当前策略的样本以及新旧奖励模型的打分。如果将奖励模型视为一组“价格”，KL正则化强化学习的一阶理论意味着每个特征的变化与其与奖励变化之间的提示内协方差成正比。我们通过包含自蒸馏安慰剂的2^(4-1)部分因子设计，将受控的价格变化植入重新训练的奖励模型中，从六个父策略出发运行了54次RL训练，并在训练开始前固定所有预测。借助协方差预测器，我们成功预测了全部20个供应量变化的方向。
tldr: 该论文基于KL正则化强化学习的一阶理论提出了一种协方差预测方法，能够在RLHF训练开始之前就预测出奖励模型修改将如何改变策略的行为，从而免去昂贵的试错式RL训练。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a covariance-based forecasting method grounded in first-order KL-regularized RL theory that predicts how policies will respond to reward-model edits before training begins, eliminating costly trial-and-error RL runs.
